transformations: Olympiad/category -> closest Machine Learning category; original title and tags retained.

Country codes are explicit ISO alpha-2 mappings of the public delegation labels, not inferred residence.
Names retain source spelling/order and are not automatically linked across events or to KAIZ profiles.
Decimal comma -> numeric point, retaining original scoreDisplay; N/A -> null score with N/A display; zero remains zero.
Missing rank -> null/unranked; tied official ranks remain shared; no rank computed from score.
Publication date remains null when not established. KAIZ verification/import timestamps are not organizer publication dates.
Existing competition metadata differences are review-only; not executed or automatically verified.
